map.title: Interactive Heritage Map
map.description: Explore India's diverse states and union territories. Click on different regions to discover their unique cultural heritage!
map.heritageDesc: Each state and union territory has its own unique cultural heritage, festivals, art forms, and monuments.
map.northernStates: Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi
map.westernStates: Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman & Diu
map.easternStates: West Bengal, Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar, Sikkim
map.southernStates: Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Puducherry, Lakshadweep
map.discoverDesc: From the snow-capped mountains of the north to the tropical beaches of the south, explore the rich cultural diversity of India through our interactive features.
